const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/lorenzkrinner/conductor/workspaces/ehl_hack/nashville/apps/web/lib/live/cockpit-view.ts
+import type { LivePlan, LiveStepStatus } from "./plan"
+import type { CaseEvent, CaseSnapshot } from "./types"
+
+export type CockpitViewItem = {
+  id: string
+  label: string
+  status: LiveStepStatus
+  detail: string | null
+  startedAt: string | null
+  completedAt: string | null
+}
+
+export type CockpitViewSection = {
+  group: string
+  label: string
+  status: LiveStepStatus
+  defaultOpen: boolean
+  items: CockpitViewItem[]
+}
+
+export type CockpitView = {
+  sections: CockpitViewSection[]
+}
+
+export function buildCockpitView(
+  _snapshot: CaseSnapshot | null,
+  plan: LivePlan | null,
+  _events: readonly CaseEvent[]
+): CockpitView {
+  if (!plan) return { sections: [] }
+
+  const sections = plan.sections.flatMap((section) => {
+    const items = section.steps
+      .filter((step) => step.status !== "pending")
+      .map((step) => ({
+        id: step.step_id,
+        label: step.label,
+        status: step.status,
+        detail: step.detail,
+        startedAt: step.started_at,
+        completedAt: step.completed_at,
+      }))
+
+    if (items.length === 0) return []
+
+    return [
+      {
+        group: section.group,
+        label: section.label,
+        status: section.status ?? "pending",
+        defaultOpen:
+          section.status === "active" ||
+          items.some((item) => item.id === plan.active_step_id),
+        items,
+      },
+    ]
+  })
+
+  return { sections }
+}
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
